main_text.p: Ab ἔδω ἔσω edo edam, fit ἔδω ἐδθίω edo, comedo.
Ab ἔλω capio, traho, fit ἔλκω ἑλκώ, ἑλκυσάω ἑλκυσάζω, pro eodem.
5. Primitivis idem significantia, primum in αίω:
φθάνω praevenio: ἀ λήξω, λήθω, λήχω, λείπω, μήθω, τλύχω, φλύχω, φθάω.
Item in σκω: Ἀρέσκω placeo, ab Ἀρέω: Ἀρήσκω.

page.notes: Several Greek words are faint and uncertain, particularly accents and diphthongs in the lines of the Greek verb forms; the Greek readings above are best effort and may contain errors. The word "fortior" and "fugio" items may be partly misprinted in the original.
